exit_criteria: CPU Rust oracle for simplified LIF, bounded integer-event and strictly Boolean recurrence.

milestones.title: Causal stimulation and bounded readout
exit_criteria: No target-derived encoding, old-bit bypass or hidden history at readout.
Reset or declare state continuity; test future-input and cross-trial leakage.
Fixed recurrence first, bounded readout only; report encoder and decoder costs.

milestones.title: Exhaustive small truth tables
exit_criteria: Evaluate AND/OR/XOR/NOT/majority/multiplexer against exact Rust truth tables.

Compare exact shift-register logic, no-reservoir readout and matched recurrent controls.

exit_criteria: Measure retention, overwrite interference, distractor response and erasure failures.

milestones.title: Compositional contextual routing

milestones.title: Perturbation and recovery

exit_criteria: Search only frozen development domains and explicit budgets; preserve every candidate identity.
